title: Ordered Tate-line presentation of the finite source
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and its completed integral coefficient sheaves [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use strict varying-coefficient derived towers and their constructible full subcategories [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism on whose source and target $\ell$ is invertible, and let $d\in\mathbf N$. Fix tower geometry $b,o,q$, a Tate presentation $w$ on $X$, and reduction towers $R_X,R_Y$. Suppose reduction of each integral constructible object on $Y$ belongs to the constructible tower category. The finiteSource functor for $(m,s)=(d,2d)$ of [def-sp-twisted-pullback-reduction-data] is naturally isomorphic to reduction on $Y$ followed by SpTowerGamma.source of [det-sp-tower-gamma], whose coefficient factor is the ordered product of $d$ degree-one Tate lines shifted by two. The isomorphism is in the ordinary derived category of entire strict towers, not just a list of evaluations. No smoothness, purity orientation, or exceptional adjoint is required.

source.place: Purity: reduction source and ordered Tate factors

proof.text: Invertibility of ell makes the Tate line locally free of rank one. The positive-power case of signed-line reduction identifies the reduction of the integral Tate d-th line with the d-fold finite Tate line, on entire systems. The fixed normalized Tate presentation identifies the degree-one factors and all quotient transitions.

Induct on d. The zero case uses the coefficient unitor. At a successor use tensor associativity and the tensor/shift comparison to place the extra Tate line shifted by two at the right of the ordered product. The cumulative shift is 2(d+1). Whisker the resulting natural comparison with the common completed reduction and derived pullback. Membership proofs in reduce are erased by its full inclusion; every factor is an entire-system comparison.

theorem integralAdjunctionSourceComparison
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (d : ℕ)
    (hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x))
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y))
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E) (o : SpTowerShriek.Operations l E b)
    (q : SpTowerCalculus.Coordinates l E b) (w : SpChartAdmissibility.Twists l E X)
    (RX : SpReductionTower l E X (q.abelian X))
    (RY : SpReductionTower l E Y (q.abelian Y))
    (hY : ∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y,
      spConstructibleTorTowers l E Y (q.abelian Y)
        ((reduction l E Y (q.abelian Y) RY).obj K)) :
    Nonempty
      (SpTwistedPullback.finiteSource l E b f (o.geometry f)
          (q.abelian X) RX (q.abelian Y) RY (d : ℤ) (2 * (d : ℤ)) ≅
        reduce l E Y (q.abelian Y) RY hY ⋙
          SpTowerGamma.source l E b o q f w d)
